SAM 2 (Segment Anything in Images and Videos) - code from https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2
at commit 2b90b9f5ceec907a1c18123530e92e794ad901a4 (2024-12-15), Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and
affiliates, Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE in this folder).

Changes for Welder: only the sam2 package (no training code, no training configs, no CUDA
extension sources; iopath replaced by a plain open() in modeling/backbones/hieradet.py - the optional hole-filling post-process falls back as upstream does); the
legacy top-level sam2_hiera_*.yaml config links are left out (the sam2.1 configs are used).
This folder goes on sys.path so the package keeps its own name (its Hydra configs are found as "sam2").

The SAM 2.1 checkpoints (facebook/sam2.1-hiera-*) are a separate download, Apache 2.0.
